title: Diffuse Irradiance Modelling in Sub-Hourly PV System Yield Simulations
content: This study aims to reduce biases in diffuse irradiance modelling at sub-hourly time scales, which is critical for accurate photovoltaic system performance simulations. Typically, this process involves estimating diffuse horizontal irradiance (DHI) from global horizontal irradiance (GHI) and then applying a decomposition model to determine the irradiance on the PV module plane. While models like Erbs and Perez are standard, they introduce biases when applied to shorter time scales (e.g., 1-minute) without adaptation. Leveraging global ground-based datasets, this work compares common DHI and decomposition models and reparametrizes their coefficients specifically for subhourly scales. The results demonstrate that these improvements reduce mean bias in yearly simulation estimates. We also discuss requirements for further improvements.
